item: R792 part A (row 315): the erase finds another process holding the store and never reports clean over it
summary: After every key is destroyed the erase asks each kept main file, log and log index with one F_GETLK, makes one non-blocking attempt to take SQLite's lock bytes, and while another process still holds the store rewrites through its kept descriptors every 100 ms for at most 2 s (the panic wipe's 15 s late pass does the same before letting go). The report's other_holder is none, held or unknown; only none shows the clean wording; the UI notice, the CLI and Help say the erase may be incomplete or could not check (x12). The unused hold=False variant gets the same treatment. Measured: a writer looping through the erase, 10 of 10 runs report held and leave no salt in its files.
